'''Pote Snitkin''' was a [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] who served [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] as both a helmsman for one of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Bantha-II cargo skiff/Legends|skiffs]] and a weapons dealer.

==Biography==
[[File:Snitkinskiff.jpg|left|thumb|Snitkin's skiff during the Skirmish at Carkoon.]]

Pote Snitkin, a [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="db" /> made a fortune [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] and obtaining "industrial secrets" in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]<ref name="Trilogy">''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]''</ref> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> After a theft went awry, he fled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where he visited [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]] in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. There, he met [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]], the [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. The [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] suggested that the Hutt would be grateful if a nearby cache of munitions used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], were to be taken.<ref name="Trilogy" />

One of his assistants was the [[Yuzzum/Legends|Yuzzum]] [[Wam Lufba/Legends|Wam Lufba]] who was called 'Blam' by the Skrilling. However, Snitkin soon found a rival in weapons specialist [[Hermi Odle/Legends|Hermi Odle]], whose work overshadowed the Skrilling's. The rivalry grew when Snitkin sabotaged one of Odle's weapons, causing the death of one of Jabba's favorite pets. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Pote Snitkin was part of the ill-fated execution party that accompanied [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] to be eaten by the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]], before the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] turned the tables on his captors and began fighting back. Pote was the driver of the second skiff, and was the last one aboard killed by Skywalker.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Phonebook.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Pote Snitkin's name in a phonebook]]
The [[Industrial Light & Magic]] crew called him "Snit Protokin."<ref name="Star Wars Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles]]''</ref>

Snitkin was first identified in the reference book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'', written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and published [[1994]]. However, the book incorrectly states that Snitkin was a member of the Nikto species.<ref name="AGuide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>
